_note: Every number here is either sourced (see 'src') or an explicit judgement call (see 'basis'). Nothing is hidden inside the model code.

financing.down_payment_basis: 25% is the conventional floor for a non-owner-occupied 1-unit purchase; 20% is occasionally available but prices worse.
financing.rate_basis: National 30-yr fixed averaged 7.55% APR on 2026-10-04 (Bankrate), with Mortgage News Daily's top-tier index at 7.57%. Investment / non-owner-occupied loans price roughly 0.50-1.00 pt above primary, so 8.25% is the central case and 7.75-8.75% the band.
rate_src: bankrate.com/mortgages/investment-property-rates/ - 30-yr fixed national average APR 7.55% on Sunday, October 04, 2026
lendingtree.com/home/mortgage/investment-property-mortgage-rates/ - investor loans run a half to a full point above residential
themortgagereports.com/27698/... - investment property rates usually 0.5%-1% higher
financing.closing_costs_basis: 2% of price for title, origination, survey, prepaids. Texas purchases commonly run 2-3% for an investor buyer.

operating.vacancy_basis: One month of turnover roughly every 12 months (8.3%). Applied uniformly because no property-level vacancy data was obtainable; the exurban and rural markets here plausibly run worse.
operating.maintenance_capex_basis: Reserve against roof, HVAC, turn costs and make-ready. Lower than the usual 10% because 11 of 12 are new construction under builder warranty; the one resale carries the full 10% in the notes.
operating.management_basis: Third-party single-family management in Texas typically 8-10% of collected rent plus a letting fee. Assumes the owner does NOT self-manage, which is the realistic case for an out-of-area investor holding across three states.
operating.leasing_fee_note: Deliberately set to zero and called out rather than buried: a half-to-full month letting fee on each turn would add roughly 4-8% of gross rent and push every result further negative.

_src: lrgrealty.com/tools/texas-new-build-taxes-hoa-reality-check/ - 'Texas averages 1.6%-2.5%. New builds in MUD districts can hit 3%+'
brazoriacountytx.gov tax estimator and bcmud21.com - confirm live MUD levies in Brazoria County
tax_rates._warning: These are MARKET-TYPICAL rates by county, not the actual levy on any specific parcel. A MUD, PID or SUD on a given subdivision can swing the figure by more than a full percentage point, which is worth more than any other single line in this model. Each seller email asks for the parcel's actual rate.
tax_rates.LA_note: Louisiana assesses residential at 10% of fair market value and grants a homestead exemption that a RENTAL DOES NOT GET. Effective rates on investor-held property are far below Texas but the exemption loss must be modelled, and Louisiana insurance more than offsets the saving.

insurance_annual._basis: Wind, hail and flood exposure dominate. Figures are order-of-magnitude for a new-build single-family at these values, not quotes. Gulf-coast and Louisiana placements have hardened sharply and are the single most volatile input after the tax rate.
insurance_annual._warning: Not quoted. Every seller email requests a bindable quote, because a $2,000 error here is $167/month of cash flow.
insurance_annual.LA_note: Calcasieu Parish (Lake Charles) took direct hits from Hurricanes Laura and Delta in 2020; the admitted market there has contracted and premiums are among the highest in the continental US.

hoa_annual._basis: Master-planned amenity communities in Texas commonly run $600-1,200/yr; rural subdivisions far less. Not confirmed for any property - requested in every email.

rent_size_premium.basis: A published ZIP or city MEDIAN rent spans all sizes and property types, including apartments. The subject homes are 2,740-3,075 sqft with 4-5 bedrooms, well above the median unit, so the median is lifted by 15% where a size-specific comp was unavailable. This is a judgement call and it flatters the results; the sensitivity table shows what happens without it.
